Technology stocks were posting strong gains on Tuesday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding nearly 0.9% in value despite a nearly 0.9% drop for the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index in recent trading.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Snap ( SNAP ) climbed over 4% on Tuesday after analysts at Wedbush raised their investment recommendation for the photo- and video-sharing website to Outperform from Netural and increased their price target for the company's stock by 75 cents to $12.25 a share.
In other sector news:
(+) Integrated Device Technology ( IDTI ) Tuesday jumped out to its best share price since January 2001 at $46.92 apiece, rising almost 12%, after agreeing to a $6.7 billion buyout offer from Renesas Electronics, which will pay $49 in cash for each of the chip-maker's shares. The transaction is expected to close during the first half of 2019, pending approval by Integrted Device shareholders and relevant regulatory authorities.
(+) Plantronics ( PLT ) was higher Tuesday, at one point rising almost 4%, after saying its recent acquisition of Polycom significantly expands its market opportunity, growing from the $1.4 billion per year headset market to $5.3 billion yearly across the content collaboration and conferencing and analytics software markets and growing to around $7.0 billion by 2022.
